U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION. NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY. BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE OF LSF9 MASTER PARTICIPATION TRUST, is the Plaintiff, and MICHAEL KUMESH AKA MICHAEL D. KUMESH, ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 08/15/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered. I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY. the 21st DAY of JANUARY 2026. at the hour of one thirty o' clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
Property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP of OLD BRIDGE, County of MIDDLESEX. and State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 23 Oakland Road, Old Bridge, NJ 08857;
Tax Lot(s): 31, in Block: 13264.21 Dimensions (Approx.): 102 x 146 Nearest Cross Street: Firethorn Rd Important :
Indicate lien information, if any, to be advertised pursuant to the Supreme Court decision of 1O/28/99 Summit Bank vs. Dennis Thiel (A-58-98),
Sheriff, kindly advertise the following:
Good Faith Estimated Upset Price: $550.401.25
Occupancy Status: Occupied by Unknown
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of FOUR HUNDRED NINETY SEVEN THOUSAND EIGHT HUNDRED TWENTY DOLLARS AND FORTY THREE CENTS ($497,820.43) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subject only to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale,
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks,
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff Attorney :
FRIEDMAN VARTOLO LLP
1325 FRANKLIN AVENUE. SUITE 160 GARDEN CITY. NY 11530
